read_only_inspector_source:
# Read-only metadata inspection. Does not instantiate or attach to any COM object.
[CmdletBinding()]
param()
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$taskOutput = 'D:/project/RFModel/build-reference/res-linear-rfsystem-20261016/post-publication/setproperty-metadata.json'
$taskInterop = 'C:/Program Files/Keysight/SystemVue2023/Examples/RF Architecture Design/RF Design Kit/Scripting/Excel_to_RF/Interop.GENESYS.dll'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskOutput) { throw 'Fresh diagnostic output required.' }
$taskAssembly = [Reflection.Assembly]::LoadFrom($taskInterop)
$taskFlags = [Reflection.BindingFlags]'Public,NonPublic,Instance,Static'
$taskAllTypes = @($taskAssembly.GetTypes())
$taskAllMethods = @($taskAllTypes | ForEach-Object { $_.GetMethods($taskFlags) })
function Convert-MethodMetadata($taskMethod) {
    [ordered]@{
        declaring_type = $taskMethod.DeclaringType.FullName
        name = $taskMethod.Name
        signature = $taskMethod.ToString()
        return_type = $taskMethod.ReturnType.FullName
        parameters = @($taskMethod.GetParameters() | ForEach-Object {
            [ordered]@{
                name = $_.Name
                position = $_.Position
                type = $_.ParameterType.FullName
                is_by_ref = $_.ParameterType.IsByRef
                is_in = $_.IsIn
                is_out = $_.IsOut
                attributes = $_.Attributes.ToString()
            }
        })
    }
}
$taskIItem = $taskAssembly.GetType('GENESYS.IItem')
$taskRecord = [ordered]@{
    schema_version = 1
    inspected_utc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
    execution_kind = 'passive_assembly_metadata_only'
    COM_activation_or_attachment_calls = 0
    application_or_UI_calls = 0
    powershell_version = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()
    clr_version = $PSVersionTable.CLRVersion.ToString()
    script_sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $PSCommandPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    interop = [ordered]@{
        path = $taskInterop
        sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $taskInterop -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
        assembly_full_name = $taskAssembly.FullName
        image_runtime_version = $taskAssembly.ImageRuntimeVersion
        all_type_count = $taskAllTypes.Count
        exported_type_count = @($taskAssembly.GetExportedTypes()).Count
        types = @($taskAllTypes | ForEach-Object {
            [ordered]@{ name = $_.FullName; is_interface = $_.IsInterface; is_import = $_.IsImport }
        })
    }
    search_scope = 'All public and nonpublic instance/static methods in all types of this single installed Interop assembly.'
    SetProperty_declarations = @($taskAllMethods | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'SetProperty' } | ForEach-Object { Convert-MethodMetadata $_ })
    SetName_declarations = @($taskAllMethods | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'SetName' } | ForEach-Object { Convert-MethodMetadata $_ })
    IItem_inherited_interfaces = @($taskIItem.GetInterfaces() | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName })
    IItem_methods = @($taskIItem.GetMethods() | ForEach-Object { Convert-MethodMetadata $_ })
    InvokeMember_runtime_overloads = @([type].GetMethods() | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'InvokeMember' } | ForEach-Object { Convert-MethodMetadata $_ })
    ParameterModifier_constructors = @([Reflection.ParameterModifier].GetConstructors() | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() })
    ParameterModifier_properties = @([Reflection.ParameterModifier].GetProperties() | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() })
    interpretation_limit = 'The existence of a ParameterModifier overload does not identify the server ABI or prove which argument needs by-reference binding. No candidate invocation is executed.'
}
$taskBytes = ([Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)).GetBytes(($taskRecord | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 15) + [Environment]::NewLine)
$taskStream = [IO.File]::Open($taskOutput,[IO.FileMode]::CreateNew,[IO.FileAccess]::Write)
try { $taskStream.Write($taskBytes,0,$taskBytes.Length) } finally { $taskStream.Dispose() }
[pscustomobject]@{
    output = $taskOutput
    interop_sha256 = $taskRecord.interop.sha256
    all_types = $taskAllTypes.Count
    SetProperty_declarations = $taskRecord.SetProperty_declarations.Count
    SetName_declarations = $taskRecord.SetName_declarations.Count
    IItem_methods = $taskRecord.IItem_methods.Count
    COM_calls = 0
} | ConvertTo-Json
